metadata.description: A library of AI web design skills: each one teaches Claude a complete visual style, with a reference site, screenshots and copy-ready components.

plugins.name: paper-notebook-landing
plugins.description: Landing pages in a warm paper-notebook style: cream paper, chunky soft serif, handwritten notes, sticky notes, a scroll-opening notebook, comic strips and a giant footer.

plugins.name: noir-gradient-law
plugins.description: Law-firm and advisory websites in a noir gradient style: pure black, bronze statue photography, a yellow-orange-red fire gradient, giant uppercase headlines, duotone-halftone photos and a 3D review carousel.

plugins.name: portal-webgl-studio
plugins.description: Immersive studio and agency sites: a full-screen three.js portal behind monospace UI, slash-scramble preloader, film grain, a 3D glass project gallery, an ask-me-anything terminal and ambient sound.

plugins.name: pointcloud-matrix-tech
plugins.description: Technology, data and AI product sites as a dark engineering document: matrix rain background, magnetic cursor, three.js point-cloud hero attracted to the mouse, voxel and wireframe twin visuals.
